title: cairn services
description: A list of services: the cards on the page. Docs: https://github.com/MorganKryze/cairn/blob/main/docs/configuration/services.md

id.description: Unique slug; becomes the detail page URL. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes.

url.description: Where the card links: https://… or an absolute path.

name.description: The card title. Plain text, or a per-locale mapping like {fr: …, en: …}.

desc.description: One line under the name: what the tool does for the visitor.

details.description: Longer text for the detail page; enables the card's Learn more link. Paragraphs split on blank lines, and CommonMark works here minus raw HTML (links, bold, lists, tables…).

images.description: Preview images on the detail page. A bare name is a file in the config dir's media/ folder; URLs and absolute paths pass through.

src.description: File in media/, URL, or absolute path.

category.description: Group id; name and order come from categories.yaml. Defaults to "other".

icon.description: dashboard-icons slug (e.g. jellyfin), URL, or /assets path, or the pair {light, dark} for a monochrome mark. dashboard-icons suffixes the ink rather than the theme, so its github-light.svg is the pale one and belongs under dark.

oneOf.description: Two images, keyed by the theme each one appears in. Both are required: half a pair paints nothing in one theme. e.g. {light: github, dark: github-light}

dark.description: Shown in the dark theme. A monochrome mark needs this: on cairn's tile a black one reads 1.40:1 against the dark theme, where the rules ask 3:1.

tags.description: Extra search words, invisible on the page. Add synonyms in every language.

selfhosted.description: true if you host this service yourself, false if it is hosted elsewhere. Shows a small flag on the card that unfurls its label on hover; omit for no flag.

state.description: Where the service stands, as you declare it. soon and retired take the link away entirely and mute the card; beta, deprecated and new only add the badge. url is optional with soon and retired.
